English and Spanish Classes

Learn a new language for free with our missionaries. Practical, fun classes for all levels.

Two languages, one purpose

We offer free English and Spanish classes. Our missionaries, who come from different countries and cultures, are happy to share their language and help you grow.

Whether you want to learn English to get ahead at work, or Spanish to communicate better, we are here to help. The classes are practical and interactive.

English classes

  • Practical conversation with native English-speaking missionaries
  • From beginner to advanced level
  • Everyday vocabulary, pronunciation and grammar
  • Ideal for improving at work or in your studies

Spanish classes

  • Perfect for people who have just arrived in Spain or who want to integrate
  • Conversational Spanish for everyday life
  • Patient teachers who adapt the pace to your needs
  • A multicultural environment where everyone learns from everyone

How do I sign up?

You don't need to bring anything — just a desire to learn. Classes are free, in small groups or one-on-one, and adapt to your schedule. We hold in-person sessions in our chapels and community spaces, and online as well if you prefer.

Many of our students end up forming lasting friendships with the missionaries and other participants. More than learning a language, it is a community experience.

Sign up for free

Write to us and tell us whether you want English or Spanish, and we will get back to you with the available times.
